messages:
sam: pushed a sign-off checklist for prompt-sets -> evals flow. mainly UX + a11y bits for the compact diff view. can ppl glance before i update the spec?
zoe: link to draft: https://figma.com/file/signoff-checklist (preview)
mike: quick UX flag: compact diff rows currently absorb keyboard focus on click, but we don't show a clear focus ring. need visible focus and larger hit target for chevrons.
anya: agree. also suggestion: change bulk CTA from 'Run and sign off' to 'Run & sign off' (ampersand keeps it short) or split into two buttons? Both have different affordances.
sam: leaning toward split CTAs (Run tests) + (Sign off) to avoid accidental signoffs after a run. Safer.
ben: accessibility nit: when a user signs off, SR users should get an announcement: "Signed off 8 tests by <user>" and the toast should be aria-live polite. also ensure the undo button is reachable.
aria: on copy: instead of 'Sign off' maybe 'Mark as reviewed' — friendlier for non-admins. Thoughts?
zoe: 'Mark as reviewed' is clearer about intent but longer. Could show 'Sign off' in compact and full label 'Mark as reviewed' in tooltip / aria-label.
uxbot: Suggestion: Use progressive disclosure for labels: concise visible label, expanded label in assistive text. Provide keyboard fallback for undo via tabbable toast.
mike: compact diff UX: when tests have comments, show a pin icon that can be toggled to surface them inline. Pin state should be persistent per-user.
anya: small perf note: lazy-load comment threads on pin toggle. keep an aria-busy indicator while loading.
ben: microcopy: unify wording — we currently alternate 'regression', 'score drop', 'negative delta'. Proposal: use 'score drop' in tables and 'regression' only in detailed docs.
sam: good standardization. I'll update the copy table.
aria: keyboard flow: tabbing through a suite should allow grouping by status (All, Needs review, Reviewed) with skip links. Add 'Skip to next unreviewed' button for power users (and aria-controls).
zoe: accessibility: respect prefers-reduced-motion for row expand animations. also ensure color isn't sole indicator for score drops. add an icon/label.
sam: action items: 1) split Run / Sign off CTAs, 2) visible focus + bigger chevrons, 3) toast with aria-live + tabbable Undo, 4) pin-to-inline-comments per-user lazy-loaded, 5) copy: use 'score drop' top-level. I'll update the figma and spec and ping for a final sweep. :white_check_mark:
